data.contenido:
Wea nao skae and earth kam from? Hao nao sun, moon and olketa star, and plande narafala samting long earth kamap? Bible givim trufala ansa taem hem sei God nao wakem olketa. So buk bilong iumi start witim olketa Bible story abaotem creation.

Olketa firstfala samting wea God wakem, hem olketa spirit man olsem hemseleva. Olketa hia angel. Bat hem wakem earth for pipol olsem iumi. So God wakem man and woman, Adam and Eve, and putim olketa insaed long wanfala naesfala garden. Bat olketa no obeyim God so olketa no fit for gohed for stap laef.

From start long taem wea God wakem Adam go kasem bigfala Flood, hem 1,656 year. Insaed long disfala taem, plande nogud pipol stap. Long heven, olketa spirit wea man no savve lukim olsem Satan and olketa nogud angel bilong hem stap. Long earth, Cain and plande narafala nogud pipol stap, and samfala barava strongfala man tu. Bat gudfala pipol tu stap long earth long datfala taem—Abel, Enoch and Noah. Long Part WAN iumi bae read abaotem olketa pipol hia and samting wea happen.

EVRI gudfala samting wea iumi garem hem kam from God. Hem wakem sun or givim iumi laet long daytaem, and moon and olketa star for givim iumi lelebet laet long naet. And God wakem earth for iumi stap insaed.

Bat sun, moon, and olketa star olketa no firstfala samting wea God wakem. Waswe, iu savve wanem nao first samting? Firstaem God wakem olketa spirit olsem hemseleva. Iumi no savve lukim olketa spirit hia, olsem iumi no savve lukim God tu. Bible hem kolem olketa spirit hia angel. God wakem olketa angel for stap witim hem long heven.

Firstfala angel wea God wakem hem barava spesol. Hem nao firstfala Son bilong God, and hem waka witim Father bilong hem. Hem helpem God for wakem evri nara samting. Hem helpem God for wakem sun, moon, olketa star, and earth bilong iumi tu.

Earth hem luk hao long datfala taem? Firstaem, no eniwan fit for stap long earth. No eni samting stap bat wata nomoa long evri ples. Bat God laekem pipol for stap long earth. So hem start for redyim evri samting for iumi. Wanem nao hem duim?

First samting earth needim hem laet. So God mekem laet from sun for shaen long earth. Hem mekem naet and day. Bihaen God mekem graon for kamap hae winim wata.

Firstaem no eni samting stap long graon. Hem luk olsem piksa wea iu lukim long hia. No eni flaoa or tree or animal. No eni fish stap long sea tu. God garem bigfala waka yet for mekem earth kamap naesfala ples for olketa animal and pipol for stap insaed.Jeremiah 10:12; Colossians 1:​15-17; Genesis 1:​1-10. Olketa Study Kwestin

LUKIM earth long hia! Evri samting luk naes tumas! Lukim grass and olketa tree, olketa flaoa and olketa animal. Waswe, iu savve which wan nao elephant and lion?

Hao nao disfala naesfala garden kamap? Iumi bae lukim hao God hem redyim earth for iumi.

First samting, God wakem green grass for kavarem graon. And hem wakem olketa difren kaen smolfala plant and tree. Olketa samting hia wea grow mekem earth luk naes. Bat olketa duim samting moa. Plande long olketa givim iumi kaikai wea teist naes tumas tu.

Bihaen God wakem fish for swim insaed long wata and olketa bird for flae long skae. Hem wakem olketa dog and puskat and horse; olketa bigfala and smolfala animal. Wanem kaen animal nao stap klosap long ples bilong iu? Waswe, iumi hapi from God wakem evri samting hia for iumi?

Then, God mekem wanfala part long earth olsem wanfala spesol ples. Hem kolem disfala ples garden bilong Eden. Hem barava naes fogud. Evri samting insaed luk naes tumas. And God laekem full earth for kamap naesfala ples olsem disfala garden.

Bat luk moa long piksa bilong disfala garden. Waswe, iu savve wanem nao God hem savve no stap long there? Bae iumi lukim.Genesis 1:11-25; 2:8, 9. Olketa Study Kwestin

WANEM nao hem difren long disfala piksa? Ia, pipol nao stap insaed. Olketa nao firstfala man and woman. Hu nao wakem olketa? Hem God nao. Waswe, iu savve long nem bilong God? Hem Jehovah. And hem kolem man and woman hia Adam and Eve.

Jehovah God wakem Adam long wei wea hem tekem samfala dust from graon and mekem wanfala perfect body, body bilong wanfala man. Then hem blow go insaed long nose bilong man hia, and Adam laef nao.

Jehovah God garem waka for Adam. Hem talem Adam for givim nem long evri difren kaen animal long there. Maet Adam hem lukluk long olketa animal for longfala taem mekem hem savve chusim best nem for evriwan long olketa. Taem Adam hem givim nem long olketa, hem start for lukim wanfala samting. Waswe, iu savve wanem nao datwan?

Evri animal garem partner bilong olketa. Olketa dadi elephant and mami elephant stap, and dadi lion and mami lion tu. Bat Adam no garem eni partner. So Jehovah mekem Adam for deepim sleep, and hem tekem wanfala bon from saed body bilong hem. Then Jehovah iusim disfala bon for wakem wanfala woman for Adam, and hem kamap waef bilong hem.

Adam hem hapi fogud! And Eve tu hem hapi tumas for stap insaed long barava naesfala garden! So tufala fit for garem olketa pikinini and stap tugeta and hapi.

Jehovah laekem Adam and Eve for stap olowe. Hem laekem tufala for mekem full earth luk naes olsem garden bilong Eden. Adam and Eve hapi tumas taem tufala tingim hao olketa savve duim diswan! Waswe, iu tu laek for share for mekem earth kamap naesfala garden? Bat hapi wea Adam and Eve kasem hem no stap olowe. Bae iumi lukim why nao olsem.Psalm 83:18; Genesis 1:26-31; 2:7-25. Olketa Study Kwestin

LUKIM samting wea happen. Olketa aotem Adam and Eve from naesfala garden bilong Eden. Waswe, iu savve why nao olsem?

Hem from tufala duim samting wea barava nogud. So Jehovah hem panisim tufala. Waswe, iu savve long nogud samting wea Adam and Eve duim?

Tufala duim samting wea God talem tufala for no duim. God sei tufala savve kaikai from olketa tree bilong garden. Bat God hem sei for no kaikai from wanfala tree, sapos olketa kaikaim olketa bae dae. Hem keepim datfala tree for hemseleva. And iumi savve hem rong for tekem samting bilong narafala man, iaman? So wanem nao happen?

Wanday, taem Eve hem stap seleva long garden, wanfala snek tok long hem. Tingim datwan! Hem talem Eve for kaikaim frut from tree wea God sei tufala mas no kaikaim. Bat taem Jehovah wakem olketa snek, hem no mekem olketa for toktok. So diswan minim narafala man nao mekem disfala snek for toktok. Hu nao datfala man?

Hem no Adam. So hem mas wanfala spirit wea Jehovah wakem bifor hem wakem earth. Hem nao olketa angel, wea iumi no savve lukim. Wanfala long olketa angel hia kamap praod tumas. Hem start for tingse hem fit for kamap wanfala ruler olsem God. And hem laekem pipol for obeyim hem winim wei for obeyim Jehovah. Hem nao angel wea mekem snek hia toktok.

Disfala angel hem trikim Eve. Taem hem sei Eve bae kamap olsem God sapos hem kaikaim datfala frut, Eve bilivim hem nao. So hem kaikaim, and Adam tu kaikaim. Adam and Eve no obeyim God, dastawe olketa lusim naesfala garden hom bilong olketa.

Bat wanday God bae mekem full earth kamap wanfala naesfala ples olsem garden bilong Eden. Bihaen, iumi bae lanem hao iu savve share long diswan. Bat distaem, iumi lukim wanem nao happen long Adam and Eve.Genesis 2:16, 17; 3:1-13, 24; Revelation 12:9. Olketa Study Kwestin

AOTSAED long garden bilong Eden, Adam and Eve kasem plande problem. Tufala need for waka hard for kaikai bilong tufala. Tufala no lukim olketa naesfala frut tree, bat tufala lukim olketa bush and nila grass grow raonem olketa. Diswan nao samting wea happen taem Adam and Eve no obeyim God and no fren moa witim Hem.

Bat samting wea moa worse winim datwan, Adam and Eve gogo for dae. Remember, God warnim olketa hao olketa bae dae sapos olketa kaikai from datfala tree. Long sem day wea tufala kaikaim, tufala gogo for dae nao. Tufala krangge tumas for no lisin long God!

Olketa pikinini bilong Adam and Eve born bihaen God aotem dadi and mami bilong olketa from garden bilong Eden. Diswan minim olketa pikinini tu bae kamap olo and dae.

Sapos Adam and Eve obeyim Jehovah, tufala and olketa pikinini bilong tufala fit for kasem hapi living. Olketa savve stap olowe and hapi long earth. No eniwan bae kamap olo, garem sik and dae.

God laekem pipol for stap olowe and hapi, and Hem promis for duim diswan wanday. Long datfala taem full earth bae luk naes tumas, and evri pipol bae healthy. And evriwan long earth bae fren gud tugeta and fren gud witim God tu.

Bat Eve hem no fren moa witim God. So taem hem bornem olketa pikinini bilong hem, hem no isi. Hem feel pain. Wei wea hem no obeyim Jehovah barava bringim hem bigfala sorre, iaman?

Adam and Eve garem plande son and dota. Taem firstborn son bilong tufala born, tufala kolem hem Cain. Mek-tu son bilong tufala hem Abel. Wanem nao happen long olketa? Waswe, iu savve? Genesis 3:16-23; 4:1, 2; Revelation 21:3,4. Olketa Study Kwestin

LUKIM Cain and Abel distaem. Tufala big nao. Cain hem wanfala farmer. Hem plantim rice and frut and kabis.

Abel hem man for lukaftarem olketa sheep. Hem laek for lukaftarem olketa smolfala sheep. Taem olketa grow big, Abel garem staka sheep for lukaftarem.

Wanday Cain and Abel givim wanfala present long God. Cain givim samfala kaikai wea hem plantim. And Abel givim best sheep wea hem garem. Jehovah hem hapi witim Abel and present bilong hem. Bat hem no hapi witim Cain and present bilong hem. Waswe, iu savve why nao olsem?

Hem no from present bilong Abel hem gud winim bilong Cain nomoa. Hem from Abel hem wanfala gudfala man. Hem lovem Jehovah and brata bilong hem. Bat Cain hem nogud man; hem no lovem brata bilong hem.



So God talem Cain for changem wei bilong hem. Bat Cain no lisin. Hem kros fogud from God laekem Abel winim hem. So Cain sei long Abel, ‘Iumi go wakabaot long field.’ Long there, taem olketa stap seleva, Cain hem hitim brata bilong hem Abel. From hem barava hitim hem witim strong hem killim hem dae nao. Cain duim barava nogud samting.

Nomata Abel dae, God still rememberim hem. Abel hem gudfala man, and Jehovah no savve forgetim man olsem hem. So wanday Jehovah God bae mekem Abel laef bak moa. Long datfala taem Abel bae no need for dae. Hem bae fit for stap hia long earth olowe. Hem bae gud tumas for savve long olketa man olsem Abel!

Bat God hem no hapi witim olketa man olsem Cain. So bihaen Cain killim dae brata bilong hem, God panisim hem taem hem sendem hem awe from famili bilong hem. Taem Cain go for stap long narafala part long earth, hem tekem wanfala sista bilong hem wea kamap olsem waef bilong hem.

Gogo, Cain and waef bilong hem start for garem olketa pikinini. Olketa narafala son and dota bilong Adam and Eve marit, and olketa tu garem olketa pikinini. So earth hem start for garem plande pipol. Bae iumi lane abaotem samfala long olketa.Genesis 4:2-26; 1 John 3:11, 12; John 11:25. Olketa Study Kwestin

TAEM pipol start for kamap staka long earth, plande long olketa duim olketa nogud samting olsem Cain. Bat wanfala man hem difren. Hem nao disfala man Eʹnoch. Eʹnoch hem wanfala man wea no fraet. Pipol wea stap raonem hem duim olketa samting wea nogud tumas, bat Eʹnoch gohed for servem God. Waswe, iu savve why nao evri pipol long datfala taem duim plande nogud samting? Tingim diswan, Hu nao mekem Adam and Eve for no obeyim God and for kaikaim frut wea God sei olketa mas no kaikaim? Ia, hem wanfala nogud angel. Bible kolem hem Satan. And hem trae for mekem evriwan for kamap nogud.

Wanday Jehovah God askem Eʹnoch for talem wanfala samting long pipol hia wea olketa no want for herem. Hem sei: ‘Gogo, God bae finisim evri nogud pipol.’ Olketa pipol hia kros fogud for herem diswan. Maet olketa trae for killim dae Eʹnoch tu. So Eʹnoch mas no fraet for talem pipol samting wea God bae duim.



God no letem Eʹnoch for laef for longfala taem midolwan long nogud pipol hia. Eʹnoch hem laef for 365 year nomoa. Why nao iumi sei “365 year nomoa”? From olketa man long datfala taem olketa moa strong and laef for longfala taem winim olketa man distaem. Tru nao, son bilong Eʹnoch, Me·thuʹse·lah hem laef for 969 year!

Bihaen Eʹnoch hem dae, pipol hia kamap moa worse. Bible hem sei ‘evri samting wea olketa tingting abaotem hem nogud evritaem,’ and ‘earth hem fulap witim raf fasin.’

Waswe, iu savve wanfala reason for why nao plande trabol stap long datfala taem? Hem from Satan garem wanfala niu wei for mekem pipol duim olketa nogud samting. Diswan nao nextfala samting wea iumi bae lane abaotem.Genesis 5:21-24, 27; 6:5; Hebrews 11:5; Jude 14, 15. Olketa Study Kwestin

SAPOS wanfala man hem wakabaot kam long iu and hem tol go kasem ruf long haos bilong iu, hao nao bae iu ting long hem? Hem wanfala giant! Wanfala taem olketa really giant stap long earth. Bible hem sei dadi bilong olketa hem olketa angel from heven. Bat hao nao olsem?

Remember, nogud angel Satan hem busy for mekem trabol kamap. Hem trae for mekem olketa angel bilong God for kamap nogud tu. Gogo, samfala angel start for lisin long Satan. Olketa finis for duim waka wea God givim long olketa long heven. And olketa kam daon long earth and mekem body bilong olketa kamap olsem olketa man. Waswe, iu savve why nao olsem?

Bible sei olketa duim diswan bikos olketa son bilong God hia lukim olketa woman wea luk naes long earth and want for stap witim olketa. So olketa kam daon long earth and maritim olketa woman hia. Bible sei diswan hem rong, bikos God mekem olketa angel for stap long heven.

Taem olketa angel and waef bilong olketa garem baby, olketa baby hia difren. Firstaem olketa no luk difren tumas. Bat olketa gohed for grow moa big, and moa strong, go kasem taem wea olketa giant nao. Olketa giant hia nogud tumas. And from olketa big and strong tumas, olketa spoelem pipol. Olketa trae for forcem evriwan for kamap nogud olsem olketa seleva.

Eʹnoch hem dae finis, bat wanfala man long earth nao hem gudfala man. Nem bilong hem Noah. Hem evritaem duim samting wea God laekem hem for duim.

Wanday God talem Noah hao Hem redi nao for finisim evribit evri nogud pipol. Bat God bae sevem Noah, famili bilong hem, and plande animal. Iumi lukim hao God duim diswan.Genesis 6:1-8; Jude 6. Olketa Study Kwestin

NOAH garem wanfala waef and thrifala son. Nem bilong olketa son hem Shem, Ham and Jaʹpheth. Each wan long thrifala son hia garem waef. So eitfala pipol nao insaed long famili bilong Noah.

God mekem Noah duim difren samting. Hem talem hem for buildim wanfala big ark. Disfala ark hem olsem bigfala ship, bat hem luk olsem big, longfala box. God hem sei: ‘Buildim datwan thri story hae, and mekem olketa rum insaed.’ Olketa rum hem for Noah and famili bilong hem, olketa animal, and kaikai wea olketa bae needim.

God talem Noah for wakem disfala ark mekem no eni wata go insaed tu. God sei: ‘Mi bae sendem wanfala big flood bilong wata and finisim full world. Evriwan wea no stap insaed long ark bae dae.’

Noah and olketa son bilong hem obeyim Jehovah and start for build. Bat olketa pipol laflaf nomoa. Olketa gohed for duim nogud samting. No eniwan bilivim Noah taem hem talem olketa samting wea God bae duim. Hem tek longfala taem for buildim ark. Bihaen plande year, hem finis. Then God talem Noah for tekem olketa animal long ark. For samfala animal God sei for tekem tufala, man wan and mere wan. Bat for narakaen animal, God talem Noah for tekem sevenfala. God talem Noah for tekem evri difren kaen bird tu. Noah duim evri samting wea God talem.

Bihaen, Noah and famili bilong hem tu go insaed ark. Then God satem door. Noah and famili bilong hem weit. Tingim sapos iu stap insaed long ark witim olketa, and iufala weit. Waswe, wanfala flood bae really kam olsem God talem?Genesis 6:9-22; 7:1-9. Olketa Study Kwestin

AOTSAED long ark, pipol gohed nomoa long evriday living bilong olketa. Olketa still no bilivim Flood bae kam. Maet olketa barava laflaf fogud. Bat then olketa no laflaf nao.

Seknomoa, wata start for foldaon. Hem foldaon from skae olsem taem iu kapsaetem wata from wanfala baket. Noah hem talem tru samting! Bat hem tu leit nao for eniwan moa for go insaed long ark. Jehovah nao hem satem door strong.

No longtaem nomoa olketa flat ples fulap long wata nao. Wata hem kamap olsem olketa bigfala river. Hem brekem olketa tree and rolim olketa big ston, and mekem bigfala noise. Olketa pipol fraet fogud. Olketa klae go ap long haefala ples. Masbi olketa ting go bak and sorre nao from olketa no lisin long Noah and go insaed long ark taem door hem still open for olketa! Bat hem tu leit nao.

Wata hem gohed for kamap big and big. For 40 day and 40 naet wata foldaon from skae. Wata go ap followim saed bilong olketa maunten, and no longtaem hem kavarem olketa barava haefala maunten tu. So olsem God hem talem finis, evri pipol and animal aotsaed long ark olketa dae. Bat evriwan insaed stap sef. Noah and olketa son bilong hem buildim ark long gudfala wei. Wata hem liftimap ark, and hem float antap long wata. Then wanday, bihaen rain hem stop, sun hem start for shaen. Evri samting luk difren tumas! Bigfala sea nomoa stap evriwea. And only samting wea stap hem ark wea float antap.

Olketa giant no stap nao. Olketa no stap moa for spoelem pipol. Evriwan long olketa dae, mami bilong olketa and evri nogud pipol tu. Bat wanem nao happen long olketa dadi bilong olketa?

Olketa dadi bilong olketa giant no pipol olsem iumi. Olketa hia angel wea kam daon for stap long earth olsem olketa man. So taem Flood hem kam, olketa no dae witim evri narafala pipol. Olketa leavim body bilong olketa olsem man, and go bak long heven olsem olketa angel. Bat God no letem olketa kamap part long famili bilong olketa angel bilong hem moa. So olketa kamap olketa angel bilong Satan. Bible kolem olketa hia olketa demon.

God mekem wanfala wind hem blow, and wata bilong flood start for go daon. Faevfala month bihaen, ark hem pas antap long wanfala maunten. Plande day go pas, and olketa insaed long ark savve lukim top bilong narafala maunten. Wata hem gohed for gogo daon.

Then Noah letem wanfala blak bird wea garem nem raven for go aot from ark. Hem flae for lelebet taem and then hem kam bak, bikos hem no savve faendem gudfala ples for stap. Hem gohed for duim diswan, and evritaem hem kam bak for rest long ark.

Noah laek for savve sapos wata hem go daon long earth, so next taem hem sendem aot wanfala kurukuru from ark. Bat datfala kurukuru hem kam bak tu bikos hem no savve faendem ples for stap. Noah sendem aot mek-tu taem, and hem tekem kam bak wanfala olive leaf long mouth bilong hem. So Noah savve wata go daon nao. Noah sendem kurukuru moa for mek-thri taem, and gogo hem faendem wanfala drae ples for stap.

So God hem tok long Noah. Hem sei: ‘Go aot from ark. Tekem full famili bilong iu and olketa animal witim iu.’ Olketa stap insaed long ark for winim wanfala year finis. So iumi savve tingim hao olketa hapi tumas for go aotsaed moa and for stap laef tu!Genesis 7:10-24; 8:1-17; 1 Peter 3:19, 20. Olketa Study Kwestin
